traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements in docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md are implemented and verified:
- Core Functionality: The valid-annotation-format rule and its helpers validate @story and @req annotation syntax and format, including @supports; they enforce the specified patterns for story paths and requirement IDs and operate on all comments in the file. - Quality Standards: The rule follows ESLint best practices with meta.docs, meta.messages, JSON schema for options, configurable patterns, and uses RuleTester-based tests. It is properly integrated into the plugin and configs. - Integration: The rule is loaded via src/index.ts and participates in the recommended/strict flat configs; it works alongside function and branch rules by scanning the same annotations in source comments. Tests for plugin configs confirm inclusion and severity. - User Experience: Error messages are specific and actionable, distinguishing missing vs invalid values and including both the offending path/ID and an example. Tests assert exact message text for many scenarios. - Error Handling: Edge cases such as missing values, malformed/multiline comments, path traversal, invalid regex configurations, and JSDoc coexistence are handled gracefully; configuration errors are reported separately while still allowing validation to proceed. - Documentation: docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md provides a detailed format specification, default and configurable patterns, and examples of valid/invalid annotations that match both the story and the tests.
The Jest test suite includes a dedicated suite for this story with extensive coverage of all listed REQs, and all tests pass. There is no evidence of any missing or unimplemented requirement from this story, so the story is fully implemented.
